description: You woke in a hollow where the beeches close overhead and the light comes down green. The mast is thick underfoot — food grows here, if you know what you're looking at. Half of what grows here will kill you, and the other half is dinner.
hazard: Deep shade, thin undergrowth sightlines. Boar own these hollows — give a sow room.
name: Beech Hollow
tagline: Deep beech shade, mast underfoot, old forest

description: You woke at the edge of an allotment colony — row on row of little garden sheds and fenced plots, the city behind you, the forest in front. The sheds are mostly empty, but the fruit trees nobody pruned are heavy, and the old compost grows good weeds.
hazard: Close to town means close to other hungry things. The sheds are picked over; the gardens aren't.
name: Allotment Edge
tagline: Garden sheds and fruit trees at the forest's edge

description: You woke in a bus depot — ranked empty buses, a timetable behind cracked glass, oil stains older than you. The city fed people here once; the shelves and lockers still remember. The woods are a walk away, and everything in them is awake.
hazard: Thin wild food. The depot feeds you until it doesn't — then the forest has to.
name: Depot Yard
tagline: Ruins close, pickings rich, woods a walk away
